name: Gleaming Light raises Illumination and Daybreak healing by 20% (#2312)
contract: Gleaming Light 704568 (SpellFamilyName 33) has one live effect: SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) and EffectBasePoints 19 -> real 20, and EffectSpellClassMask word 2 bits 0x200|0x20000000 (536871424). Illumination's base spell (500143) carries SpellFamilyFlags_2 0x200 (512) and Daybreak (500147) carries SpellFamilyFlags_2 0x20000000 (536870912) -- together exactly the shipped mask, so both named spells are affected. Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone calls modOwner->ApplySpellMod(spellProto->Id, SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, heal) for heals the same way damage does, a PCT-type op that multiplies the base by (100 + mod)/100 -- 1000 -> 1200 for each. The 'spell_modifier' query metric calls this same native Player::ApplySpellMod(spell, SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, base) path directly, without casting or needing a target. Native handlers only; regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Without the talent Illumination's modifier base is unchanged
Gleaming Light raises Illumination's healing by 20%
Without the talent Daybreak's modifier base is unchanged
Gleaming Light raises Daybreak's healing by 20%
